entry.content: request_quote: inputSchema parameters: +input.customer_named_business input.customer_named_business description: true only if the customer asked for exactly this business by its name on their own, e.g. "Frag bitte bei Malerbetrieb Sommer an". Never set it because the business came up in a search, because you chose it, or to get a request through to a business marked requests_paused that the customer did not name. Its only effect: one more request can go to a business marked requests_paused. Leave it out in every other case. Only with business_id; it has no effect together with business_ids search_businesses: outputSchema parameters: +output.results.requests_paused output.results.requests_paused const: true output.results.requests_paused description: Only set when true: this business takes no further requests through Bookvia right now, and other businesses can take one. It is listed after all others. Offer the customer one of the other businesses. Only if the customer asked for exactly this business by name on their own, call request_quote with customer_named_business: true. Its public contact details are in its profile +(one exception: see requests_paused) +output.unverified.requests_paused output.unverified.requests_paus

entry.content: brief: description, outputSchema -Recomputed hourly during +Updates about once an hour while -session. +market is open, the first a little after 10 AM ET. The reading settles at 4:30 PM ET; the scorecard row follows the last settled close. parameters: +output.nextUpdateAt output.nextUpdateAt description: The expected time of the next update to the reading or the stress gate (UTC). When one hourly update is due to both, this is the time both are expected to be in; otherwise, whichever comes first. An expectation, not a promise: it counts the scheduled updates of US trading sessions, and one can arrive a little earlier or later. A later correction to a settled reading is not counted. A pre-save link and cover art can be added with update_block (links, imageUrl). parameters: +input.artist input.artist description: Upcoming releases: the artist's name. +input.kind input.kind description: Upcoming releases: a song (track) or an album. Default track. input.kind enum: ["track", "album"] +input.releaseAt input.releaseAt description: When it comes out (the countdown ends and reminder emails go out within the hour), ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00-08:00. Ask the user's time zone if unsure. null clears it. +input.title input.title description: Upcoming releases: the song or album title. +Leave it out for a release that isn't out yet. update_block: description, inputSchema -title +title, artist, releaseAt, cover art (imageUrl) parameters: +input.artist input.artist description: Music buttons only: the artist's name. -Links only: +Links: -link. Music buttons: new cover art. +Before the release date these show as pre-save links. +input.releaseAt input.releaseAt description: Music buttons only: the release date.
